# oversight-ladder

> A human-oversight obligation standard keyed to loomground's ratified L0-L6 autonomy ladder: per-rung `.lg` declarations plus a Python lookup from a rung, or an escalation ceiling, to what that rung's human-facing obligation point requires.

## Problem
An autonomy grade (L0-L6) says how much a system may do unattended; it does not say what a human overseer is owed at that grade. oversight-ladder reads the ladder and the ceiling calculus from loomground read-only and adds the missing layer: one `.lg` obligation declaration per rung, and a table mapping a rung (or an escalation result) to its obligation, its AI Act Art. 14 grounding, and the oversight-certificate facets it should satisfy when exercised. It mints no ladder of its own.

## Install
```
pip install "oversight-ladder @ git+https://github.com/flxk1/oversight-ladder@v0.1.0"
```
The package builds and installs standalone; the ladder and the ceiling calculus are resolved at runtime by reading a sibling `loomground-repos/` checkout on disk (loomground-governance, loomground-escalation, loomground-ref) rather than as installable dependencies. Clone or keep that checkout as this repo's sibling directory, or set `OVERSIGHT_LADDER_LOOMGROUND_REPOS` to its path. Requires `loomground_solver` importable (loomground-escalation's one dependency).

## Usage
```python
from oversight_ladder.obligations import obligation_for, rung_table, CERTIFICATE_FACETS
from oversight_ladder.ladder import grade_levels, ladder_info
from oversight_ladder.escalation_bridge import resolve, resolve_with_escalation
from oversight_ladder.validator import validate_file
from oversight_ladder.biometric import biometric_addon_path

grade_levels()                       # ('L0', ..., 'L6') — read from grades.json, never hardcoded
ob = obligation_for("L3")
ob.status, ob.art14, ob.summary, ob.lg_file, ob.certificate_facets

# a rung by escalation ceiling rather than by name
ob = resolve(factors, delegated="L2")            # loomground_escalation.Factor instances
ob, escalation = resolve_with_escalation(factors, delegated="L2")
escalation.why(), escalation.binding, escalation.unassessed

# validate a rung's .lg patch against loomground's own checker
validate_file(oversight_ladder.obligations.lg_path("L4"))   # engine="ref" (default) or "skill"
```

No CLI or MCP tool is exposed; the package is consumed as a library.

## Contracts
| Surface | Definition |
|---|---|
| Rung obligation table | `oversight_ladder.obligations.rung_table()`, `.obligation_for(rung)`; `RungObligation` (`rung`, `label`, `status`, `art14`, `summary`, `lg_file`, `certificate_facets`, `grounding`) |
| Per-rung `.lg` declarations | `lg/L0.lg` … `lg/L6.lg`, one per rung; `lg/biometric-two-person.lg` (Art. 14(5) two-person add-on, outside the core ladder, no default `grade`) |
| Ladder read | `oversight_ladder.ladder.grade_levels()`, `.grade_grounding()`, `.ladder_info()`, `.autonomy_ladder()` — read from `loomground-governance/standard/vocabulary/grades.json`, never hardcoded |
| Escalation bridge | `oversight_ladder.escalation_bridge.resolve(factors, delegated=...)`, `.resolve_with_escalation(...)` — wraps `loomground_escalation.ceiling()` |
| `.lg` validator | `oversight_ladder.validator.validate_text` / `.validate_file` — dual-engine (`loomground-ref`, and the loomground-governance skill's cached copy) |
| Certificate facets cited | `CERTIFICATE_FACETS = ("human-authorship-attestation", "reasoned-rationale", "considered-record")` — RVND's `rvnd-pack/commons/commons.json`, cited by name, not recomposed |
| Biometric add-on | `oversight_ladder.biometric.biometric_addon_path()` |

Dependency direction: `oversight-ladder` -> `loomground-governance` / `loomground-escalation`, read-only, never the reverse. RVND enforces against the facets this repo names; it does not implement the gate or the certificate itself.
